caption: The drawing depicts a quilt-like pattern composed of concentric diamond star shapes and connecting circular and diamond motifs. There are three large eight-pointed stars: one centered and two partially shown at the top left and bottom left corners. Each star is made up of small diamond shapes in a variety of colors, including shades of red, blue, green, yellow, pink, and purple. These stars are surrounded by a white or very light gray background. Green elliptical and diamond shapes form a lattice-like structure, framing the stars and intersecting between large empty white areas. The drawing is bordered by a plain off-white background and is signed at the bottom with the words "Westchester County" on the left, and "Gladys Phillips" on the right.
title: Patchwork Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
